title: Book a VirSME Workflow Demo
description: Bring one real business workflow and see how VirSME can connect the people, records, rules, actions and approvals around it.
hero: Show us the workflow that is slowing your business down.
intro: Do not prepare for a generic software presentation. Choose one process that currently crosses teams, tools, policies or manual handoffs.

items: Processes driven by SOPs and policies
Any process that depends on spreadsheets, email, WhatsApp or repeated data entry

blocks.text: You explain the current process. We identify the people, records, systems, rules and handoffs involved. We show the relevant VirSME operating approach. If there is a fit, we move into deeper discovery and commercial scoping.
There is no generic trial or pilot period. If both sides see a fit, the next step is discovery, configuration planning and a commercial proposal.
